description.en: Read an accessible workspace record or Thread Attachment, or open a matched File using its exact Area, generation, path and digest. Use representation=model_input to select an attachment or image for the next inference; use attachment_copy to save an attachment in the Working Area. To read a Subnode created by this Run, pass its workspace_id. Text records return bounded chunks with next_offset.
Ask the human for input and wait for a response. Approval requests do not grant permission until answered.
Ask the person who started this Run to connect an MCP server. Available in every Approval Mode. Waits and returns {connected: bool}; connect missing plugin servers to make their tools available.

Read a bounded summary of goal, tasks, artifact references, messages and recent event metadata. Messages list Thread Attachment metadata without bytes. Use workspace_read for full records. Collections have separate totals and next_offset; events/messages are newest first. Refresh pagination if the workspace changes.
Search the Workspace index by text or by an image in your own Working Area. Image matches are File pointers; open a match with workspace_read.

Wait without inference for a Task you created or delegated to finish, block or fail, or for a message or person. The default is 60 minutes while your Tasks remain unfinished and 5 minutes otherwise; the maximum is 60 minutes. The result summarizes changes. For remote Tasks, use workspace_observe to read details after a change.
Native skill_list
Native skill_load
Native skill_read
Native file_search
Native file_read
Decompose a goal or task. Create a subtask in this workspace; returns its ID. Delegate it next. A subtask nobody is given is abandoned when this Run finishes.
Offer an existing workspace task to the explicitly selected local or remote agent.
Find local and federated agents by capability, skill, tag, language or model. Choose an exact node_id, entity id and version from these results.
Publish an intermediate artifact to the shared workspace.
Send a message to the human and other agents sharing this workspace. Optionally attach snapshots of up to eight current Working Area files by path (8 MiB total).
Copy a visible Thread Attachment into the Working Area. Supply the current area revision and a unique idempotency key. The File records its source message and attachment.

Explicitly add, correct, or delete individual unverified memory units in the host-bound private bank. Corrections and deletions require the caller-observed expected_revision. Preserve exact evidence. Never replace a bank.

Bank.description: Issued by the Home authority for a participant, independently of a definition version.

participant.description: `None` is the explicitly published Workspace bank.

mental_model.description: A recurring question, retained independently of the current generated answer.

aliases.description: Explicit source/model-resolved names, including cross-language aliases.

oneOf.description: Exact selected disclosure grant; source lineage is resolved at the Home.

Verification.description: Verification is separate from admission and model confidence.

description.en: Recall bounded current memory from the Home's bound participant using semantic, keyword, graph and temporal search. Preserve provenance and uncertainty.
Explicitly reflect over currently admitted memory with bounded exact-citation reads. This operation does not admit new learning.

Search this agent's Discoverable capabilities (tools and Skills) by keywords; an empty query lists all. Results give each alias, kind, summary, digest and whether it is loaded. Continue with next_cursor when truncated.
Describe one Discoverable capability by alias: its exact identity and digest, the full tool definition or Skill file inventory, and the bytes it uses of its exposure budget.

Load a Discoverable capability by alias and digest. A loaded tool can be called and loaded Skill instructions appear from the next request. Loading never evicts anything; when the budget is exceeded, unload a capability first.
Unload a loaded or eager capability by alias to free its exposure budget from the next request. Mandatory capabilities cannot be unloaded.
Read a file packaged with a Skill by its capability alias, digest and relative path. Continue from next_offset when present. Binary files return metadata only.

Assign a workspace task to an approved existing agent, or request a generated specialist using an explicitly named generation policy. Generation may wait for human approval. Requires a tenant-scoped execution identity.
Create a Run-scoped Subnode with approved members and a narrower allowance. Name built-in tools by operation and other tools as registry_deployment/tools/id@version.
Give a task to a Subnode's leader.
Add an approved agent version to a Subnode.
Remove a member without unfinished work from a Subnode.
Dissolve a Subnode created by this Run and cancel its active Runs.
Send a message to the Run that created this Subnode.

Read one accessible workspace record by kind and exact ID. Returns a JSON text chunk, total_chars and next_offset; concatenate chunks in offset order to recover the full record. The returned chunk is capped to fit the active request budget. If budget_limited is true, continue from next_offset on a later turn; if deferred is true, stop reading until that later turn.

Read a bounded summary of goal, tasks, artifact references, messages and recent event metadata. Use workspace_read for full records. Collections have separate totals and next_offset; events/messages are newest first. Refresh pagination if the workspace changes.
Send a message to the human and other agents sharing this workspace.

Read one accessible workspace record by kind and exact ID. Messages list Thread Attachment metadata without bytes. Use kind=attachment to read metadata or representation=model_input to select media for the next inference; use attachment_copy to save one in the Working Area. Other records return a JSON text chunk, total_chars and next_offset; concatenate chunks in offset order to recover the full record. The returned chunk is capped to fit the active request budget. If budget_limited is true, continue from next_offset on a later turn; if deferred is true, stop reading until that later turn.
Keep history needed to answer the current request while pruning unnecessary tool calls and results.
